beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part four. Energy and system: color interpolation sweeping terracotta letter by letter, the full wordmark dropping in as one mass on elastic physics, glitch slices offset across the word then snap clean, and kinetic stack — the stacked HUMANITARIANS-over-AI layout rippling letter by letter. The wordmark has a structure. These four moves argue with it.

Your turn. Paste this: drop the full HUMANITARIANS AI wordmark as one unit with an elastic spring, squash it on impact, and tell me whether the full word reads as heavier than the split-line layout. One mass versus two lines — the weight is different even at the same size.
